actions.create_item.description: Creates a new report item in Weekdone.
actions.create_item.props.description.de: The text content of the report item.
actions.create_item.props.due_on.descrip: The due date for this item in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2024-03-15"). Leave empty for no due date.
actions.create_item.props.is_private.des: If enabled, only you can see this item. If disabled (default), the item is visible to your team.
actions.create_item.props.period.descrip: The report week to add this item to, in YYYYWW format (e.g. "202403" for week 3 of 2024). Leave empty to use the current week.
actions.create_item.props.priority.descr: The priority level for this item.
actions.create_item.props.source_id.desc: The ID of this item in an external system (e.g. a JIRA ticket number or Asana task ID). Maximum 50 characters.
actions.create_item.props.team_id.descri: The team to add this item to. Leave empty to use your primary team.
actions.create_item.props.type_id.descri: The category this item belongs to in your weekly report. Custom category IDs (4 and above) are available via the Custom API Call action.
actions.create_item.props.user_id.descri: The user to assign this item to. Leave empty to assign it to yourself.
actions.create_objective.description: Creates a new OKR objective in Weekdone.
actions.create_objective.props.descripti: The text of the objective (e.g. "Grow revenue by 20% this quarter").
actions.create_objective.props.level_det: Additional fields required for the selected objective level.
actions.create_objective.props.period.de: The quarter this objective belongs to in YYYYQ format (e.g. "2024Q1" for Q1 2024, "2024Q3" for Q3 2024). Leave empty to use the current quarter.
actions.create_objective.props.type.desc: The level this objective applies to. Company objectives apply to the whole organisation; Department, Team, and Personal are scoped to a specific group or individual.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.update_item.description: Updates an existing report item in Weekdone.
actions.update_item.props.description.de: The new text content for the item. Leave empty to keep the current value.
actions.update_item.props.due_on.descrip: The new due date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2024-03-15"). Leave empty to keep the current value.
actions.update_item.props.item_id.descri: The report item to update. Change "Search Week" above to find items from other weeks.
actions.update_item.props.move_to_period: Required when changing the Report Category. The week to move the item into, in YYYYWW format (e.g. "202403").
actions.update_item.props.priority.descr: The new priority level for this item. Leave empty to keep the current value.
Filter the item list by week in YYYYWW format (e.g. "202403" for week 3 of 2024). Leave empty to search the current week.
actions.update_item.props.type_id.descri: Move this item to a different report category. If you change this, you must also fill in "Target Week" below.
actions.update_objective.description: Updates the description of an existing OKR objective in Weekdone.
actions.update_objective.props.descripti: The new text for the objective.
actions.update_objective.props.objective: The objective to update. Use "Filter by Level" and "Filter by Quarter" above to narrow the list.
actions.update_objective.props.search_pe: Narrow the objective list by quarter in YYYYQ format (e.g. "2024Q1"). Leave empty to show objectives from all periods.
actions.update_objective.props.search_ty: Narrow the objective list by level to make it easier to find the one you want.
description: OKR & weekly status reporting tool for teams.
triggers.new_item.description: Triggers when a new item is added to a Weekdone report.
triggers.new_item.props.team_id.descript: Only trigger for items added to this team. Leave empty to receive items from all teams.
triggers.new_item.props.user_id.descript: Only trigger for items belonging to this user. Leave empty to receive items from all users.
triggers.new_objective.description: Triggers when a new OKR objective is added in Weekdone.
triggers.new_objective.props.period.desc: Only trigger for objectives in a specific quarter. Use YYYYQ format (e.g. "2024Q1") or a full year (e.g. "2024"). Leave empty to watch all periods.
triggers.new_objective.props.type.descri: Only trigger for objectives at a specific level. Leave empty to receive objectives from all levels.
